testcase.name: anonymous users cannot read protected API or Studio
invalid login is clear and clears password
guest can learn, survives refresh, but cannot enter Studio
admin accesses verified Studio; logout invalidates session
logout without CSRF token is denied and session remains valid
existing lesson routes remain accessible to guests
Studio rejects a successful response with invalid content
failed logout is not reported as success and permits recovery
focus revalidation preserves the current learning step
logout in another tab revokes the visible session
revoked session on focus returns to sign in
session service failure shows retry rather than exposing lessons
guest can step, restart and switch caption language
guest can explore DSA topics
guest can run the Java playground without author privileges
